packageRules.description: Retain Python 3.14 across runtime version files and official Docker images until a coordinated IJT compatibility migration. Allow 3.14 patches and existing Docker digest refreshes; do not restrict PyPI dependency updates. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

Retain the Python 3.14 component of the combined Web Client image without imposing a new Node.js version restriction. Lift this hold with the official Python runtime rule during a coordinated migration.

Group uv CLI, workflow steps, and Docker image updates together into a single atomic toolchain update so CI runners, bootstrap scripts, and container images remain strictly synchronized to the same uv release.

Group cryptography and pyOpenSSL together: pyOpenSSL places an explicit upper-bound ceiling on the cryptography version it accepts (e.g. pyOpenSSL 26.3.0 requires cryptography<50). Bumping them independently creates impossible pip resolves. A single combined PR ensures both floors are updated only when a new pyOpenSSL release extends its cryptography upper bound.
Group Python dev tool updates (mypy, ruff, bandit, pip-audit) into a single weekly reviewed PR with a 3-day minimum release age.
Group pytest ecosystem updates into Python development tools weekly reviewed PR.
pre-commit manager is opt-in (:enablePreCommit). Limit it to zizmor-pre-commit only — other hooks often use SHA/frozen pins and stay manual.
Keep root-runner PyPI zizmor, pre-commit zizmor-pre-commit, and ci.yml zizmor-action version input on the same semver. GHA zizmor-action *SHA* stays on Dependabot.

Group Docker digest refreshes into one weekly reviewed PR. Digest churn is normal, but daily one-image PRs add CI load without improving safety. No needs-manual-review label: digests stay visible as normal PRs for human merge after CI (no automerge).
Batch Playwright monorepo updates weekly so Browser CI image refreshes are deliberate and reuse the fingerprint-cache path instead of producing daily PR pressure.

Docker OS base-image version bumps (ubuntu, debian, alpine…) must pass CI before merging. Excludes digest-only updates so the weekly docker-digests group is not re-labeled needs-manual-review (Renovate merges addLabels across matching rules).
Hold OPCFoundation.NetStandard.Opc.Ua major updates until IJT C# companion types and build profiles are migrated to Roslyn source generation for SDK 2.0. See PR #598 for context.
